item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Amnesty reported excessive use of force and widespread arrests during opposition-led protests; the excerpt says media videos alleged attacks and arrests, the Home Minister stated that around 700 people were detained over the weekend, and two people had died and hundreds of protesters and police had been hospitalized since protests began the previous December.","notes":["The excerpt does not provide the statement date of 31 July 2023.","The two deaths and hospitalizations are described as occurring since protests began the previous December, not specifically during 28–29 July.","The excerpt attributes attacks and arrests to allegations in media videos, not as established Amnesty findings."]}]}
